races.name: Ascot Shop Royal Ascot Two-Year-Old Trial EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Adaay Of Scarlett
runners_data.note: Won impressively on debut but prominent style may not suit if pace is honest here.

runners_data.name: A Bear Affair
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to likely race shape, with Hannon 5/50 strike-rate a concern but horse has quality.

runners_data.name: Crusherman
runners_data.note: Will lead but exposed level after finishing last, though 3lb weight allowance helps his cause.

runners_data.name: Dance A Jig
runners_data.note: Another closer who should benefit from the race setup, with Beckett's 4/20 form better than rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Crusherman will lead from the gates with no pace pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate fractions. Adaay Of Scarlett will track prominently behind the leader, while A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig will settle towards the rear looking for cover. The sustainable pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to unleash late runs down Ascot's testing straight. This race shape strongly favours closers who can quicken late over the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Crusherman sets modest fractions and the hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The sustained pace allows A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig to wind up their finishing kicks down the straight. Both closers benefit from the tactical setup and superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Adaay Of Scarlett gets first run on the leaders turning for home
scenarios.body: The winner can capitalize on ideal positioning behind the pace-setter while the hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the move. Adaay Of Scarlett's tactical speed proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Crusherman gets very soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure to save energy for a telling burst. The closers leave their runs too late on ground that may be quicker than advertised.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and becomes a sprint from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: All four horses converge in the final furlong creating a blanket finish. Class and fitness separate them in a scrambled conclusion where any horse can prevail.

watchPoints.text: Watch if A Bear Affair gets badly boxed in behind the small field as hold-up horses need clear runs
Monitor Crusherman's early fractions as he could steal this if allowed ultra-soft splits
Check Adaay Of Scarlett's position turning in as prominent runners need to be handy in sprint finishes
Observe if the Good going is riding faster as this would favour speed over stamina
Watch for any market moves on Dance A Jig given Beckett's better recent trainer form

races.name: Longines Sagaro Stakes (Group 3) (A Gold Cup Trial)

runners_data.name: Ascending
runners_data.note: Returns from 215-day break but showed excellent form before the layoff and should handle the step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Caballo De Mar
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form who should get an ideal pitch tracking Tarriance and has strong recent Ascot form.

runners_data.name: Sweet William
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest official rating but faces traffic concerns given his running style and the race composition.

runners_data.name: Tarriance
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who will dictate terms and benefit from the lack of early pace pressure in this field.

runners_data.name: Tabletalk
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose trainer is having a poor spell but the horse showed good form when second last time out.

runners_data.name: Deira Mile
runners_data.note: Long absence of 391 days makes him hard to recommend despite his hold-up style potentially suiting if he's fit enough.

runners_data.name: Dubai Future
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer whose recent form suggests he retains ability but needs luck in running from his style.

runners_data.name: Beylerbeyi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Ryan Moore aboard who showed improved form last time and handles good ground well.

runners_data.name: Miss Alpilles
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner returning from a long break who will need significant improvement to feature prominently.

races.paceDynamic: Tarriance will take the field along at a measured gallop with Ascending and Caballo De Mar likely to track just behind in the early stages. The lack of natural pace pressure means Tarriance can dictate terms without being harried, creating a scenario where the tempo may not be truly testing until the final 4-5 furlongs. With six of nine runners adopting hold-up tactics, there's a significant risk of a cavalry charge developing from the rear. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Tarriance gets soft sectionals and isn't pressured early.
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow to set up the race for closers, allowing those who race prominently to have first run on the field. Ascending and Caballo De Mar can track the leader and strike when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ascending or Caballo De Mar apply early pressure to Tarriance.
scenarios.body: A genuine gallop throughout will stretch the field and create gaps for the better stayers to exploit in the final furlong. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up the ground against a solid pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and the field bunches entering the straight.
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses will be looking for racing room simultaneously, causing interference and blocking runs. Only the hold-up horses with the clearest passages will be competitive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Stayer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the leaders weaken markedly.
scenarios.body: The race will become a test of stamina rather than tactical positioning, suiting horses with proven staying power over those relying on pace tactics. Sweet William's class could tell in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: Sweet William could be trapped wide or behind a wall of horses given six hold-up runners and his need for a strong pace.
Tarriance's ability to dictate fractions unchallenged - if given too easy a lead he becomes very dangerous.
Traffic problems in the straight are almost inevitable with so many hold-up horses converging simultaneously.
Ascending's fitness after 215 days off - any signs of rustiness early could compromise his chances.
The pace through the middle sections - if too steady it will compromise all the hold-up horses' chances.

races.name: Commonwealth Cup Trial Stakes (Registered As The Pavilion Stakes) (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Coppull
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 216-day break under in-form Rossa Ryan, though Cox's poor recent record is concerning.

runners_data.name: Brussels
runners_data.note: Aidan O'Brien's consistent prominent racer with Ryan Moore booked, solid record on similar going and distance.

runners_data.name: Division
runners_data.note: Haggas-trained prominent horse with excellent recent 6f form, though 195 days off track raises fitness questions.

runners_data.name: Wise Approach
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with perfect 6f record on good ground, Buick's tactical expertise crucial from the back.

runners_data.name: Crown Relic
runners_data.note: Lone front runner stepping up in class, recent run just 24 days ago suggests Burke has him primed for this.

runners_data.name: Ghost Mode
runners_data.note: Improving prominent horse with headgear retained, form figures suggest he's learning his trade quickly.

runners_data.name: Ardisia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong 6f record but recent 7f runs suggest stamina limitations may have been exposed.

runners_data.name: Midnight Tango
runners_data.note: Back-marker carrying 3lbs less than rivals but 203 days off track makes fitness a major concern.

races.paceDynamic: Crown Relic stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will get an uncontested lead at a comfortable gallop over this 6f trip. With no other natural pace-makers, the prominent racers Coppull, Brussels and Division will likely track Crown Relic in a compact group, while the hold-up horses Wise Approach and Ardisia will be further back looking for a gap. The lack of pace pressure means Crown Relic can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march, but also sets up perfectly for closers to deliver their trademark late kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing speed from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Crown Relic sets modest fractions unchallenged and the pace quickens late
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kicks when it matters most. Wise Approach and Ardisia are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup with their proven ability to quicken from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Crown Relic steals significant lengths early and the field responds too late
scenarios.body: Crown Relic exploits the lack of pace pressure to build an unassailable advantage, with prominent racers failing to close the gap quickly enough. The lone leader benefits from having the race run to suit perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply early pressure to Crown Relic and sustain their effort
scenarios.body: Brussels, Coppull and Division force a stronger gallop that blunts Crown Relic's kick while setting up their own sustained drives. The tactical battle between prominent runners creates the perfect tempo for their running styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure creates such modest fractions that no horse can establish a decisive advantage in the final furlong. Superior class rather than tactics determines the outcome in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Crown Relic's early fractions will determine everything - if he gets away with soft sectionals, closers benefit massively.
Brussels and Coppull must avoid getting drawn into an early pace battle that could compromise their finishing kicks.
Wise Approach's position turning for home will be crucial given his hold-up style needs room to maneuver.
Division's fitness after 195 days layoff could be exposed if the pace becomes genuinely testing early.
Ghost Mode's headgear retention suggests connections expect another forward move from this improving type.

races.name: Memberships At Ascot Paradise Stakes (Listed Race) (A Queen Anne Stakes Trial)

runners_data.name: Holloway Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent Haydock win but 62 days off and needs pace collapse to be effective

runners_data.name: Rashabar
runners_data.note: Quality hold-up type returning from 181-day layoff under in-form James Doyle, requires strong gallop to show best

runners_data.name: La Botte
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with modest recent form, needs significant pace bias to trouble these on ratings

runners_data.name: Chancellor
runners_data.note: Prominent racer ideally positioned to track the pace, headgear applied suggests connections expect improved effort

runners_data.name: Jonquil
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form but 83 days since last run may blunt finishing speed

runners_data.name: Seacruiser
runners_data.note: Hold-up type in good current form with quick 21-day turnaround, likely needs luck in running

runners_data.name: Remmooz
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 224-day break with strong course record, tactical position crucial

runners_data.name: Bowmark
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner with 251-day layoff under Ryan Moore, sustainable pace gives him every chance

runners_data.name: Naqeeb
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 219-day absence, veteran needs everything to fall right at this level

races.paceDynamic: Bowmark holds the sole lead with no obvious early speed rivals, creating a controlled and sustainable gallop from the start. Chancellor and Remmooz may track prominently but neither appears keen to challenge for the lead early. The majority field comprising hold-up horses like Holloway Boy, Rashabar, Jonquil and La Botte will settle behind the modest tempo. This creates a tactical advantage for prominent racers and those with proven finishing speed, as the steady pace allows stalkers to position ideally while potentially catching out pure hold-up horses if the kick comes too late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Chancellor or Remmooz track Bowmark closely without pressuring the leader
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up perfectly for horses settling in second or third to strike with sustained runs from 2f out. Patient prominent horses get first run on the field while pure hold-up types find insufficient pace collapse to exploit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If Bowmark goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish from 1f out
scenarios.body: The pedestrian pace allows closers maximum opportunity to unleash their finishing speed in a bunched field finish. Quality hold-up performers like Holloway Boy and Rashabar prove too strong in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bowmark Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his advantage turning for home without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The front-runner's class tells as he kicks clear when the field comes to challenge, with his 251-day break overcome by Ryan Moore's tactical nous. Late closers struggle to make up the deficit despite their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field remains tightly bunched entering the final 2f with multiple challengers
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where positioning and racing luck become crucial factors rather than pure ability. Several horses arrive together with the outcome decided by traffic problems and who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Bowmark's 251-day layoff could catch up with him if pressed hard from 2f out by fresher rivals
Chancellor's headgear application suggests trainer expects improvement but could indicate behavioral issues
Multiple hold-up horses including Rashabar and Jonquil returning from lengthy breaks may lack peak fitness
Track Remmooz's early positioning as prominent runner returning from long absence needs to settle kindly
Watch for Holloway Boy's trademark late run but he needs others to go too fast early to be maximally effective

runners_data.name: Combustion

races.paceDynamic: Artagnan will lead from the gates with his prominent style and recent course form, likely joined early by All Ways Glamorous and Far Above The Law who both race prominently. This trio will establish a solid gallop over the minimum trip, but nothing suggests they'll go crazy early given Artagnan's sustainable racing pattern. The large field of 17 runners creates natural compression behind the leaders, with multiple hold-up horses like Pixie Diva, Existent and Rage Of Thunder needing to weave through traffic in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early leaders who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Sustain Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Artagnan and the prominent pack maintain a solid but manageable pace without burning out.
scenarios.body: The front trio stay clear of trouble while the large field bunches behind them, creating a wall of horses that prevents the hold-up horses from getting clear runs. Early positioning proves decisive over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight, allowing the classiest hold-up horses with the best jockeys to find gaps.
scenarios.body: Ryan Moore's race-reading on Pixie Diva and Cieren Fallon's big-race experience on Another Abbot become crucial as they navigate through the pack. Superior class and jockey skill overcome poor positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Pack Emergence
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and horses from midfield positions get first run on the leaders.
scenarios.body: Runners like Emperor Spirit and Mesaafi, racing prominently but not committed to the lead, get the perfect trip as they sit behind the pace and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize. They avoid both pace pressure and traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Long Break
scenarios.trigger: If Artagnan or another front-runner kicks clear early and the field fails to respond quickly enough.
scenarios.body: The combination of the Good to Firm ground and minimum distance means any horse getting a clear break of 2-3 lengths in the final furlong becomes very difficult to catch. The chasing pack gets in each other's way trying to respond.

watchPoints.text: Watch the early pace as Artagnan breaks from the gates - if he goes too fast early he could set it up for the closers
Monitor the traffic situation turning for home with 17 runners - hold-up horses like Pixie Diva and Existent could get buried
Keep an eye on All Ways Glamorous despite the long absence - this filly has won fresh before and races prominently
Watch for Emperor Spirit and Another Abbot who both return from breaks but have class and good jockeys to overcome rustiness
Note the 7lb claiming riders on Artagnan and Rage Of Thunder - the weight relief could prove significant in a competitive handicap

runners_data.name: Lyrics Of Life
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent placings, needs strong early pace to unleash her finishing kick.

runners_data.name: Annastarzy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long break, inconsistent recent form but handles the going conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Gesayed will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge her early. So Regal, Light Dreamer and Annastarzy will track prominently but none are natural pace forcers, creating a measured tempo through the early stages. The pace will remain sustainable until the turn for home when the prominent runners begin their challenges. This moderate tempo and lack of early pressure heavily favours horses that can track the pace and kick, making prominent runners and those with tactical speed the preferred profiles over pure hold-up specialists.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Gesayed Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Gesayed maintains a steady lead without early pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows her to conserve energy while the field remains bunched, setting up a sprint finish where tactical speed matters most. Prominent runners with pace-tracking ability are perfectly positioned to strike in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If So Regal or Light Dreamer press forward early to challenge Gesayed's lead
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and tests stamina over this mile trip, creating gaps that hold-up horses can exploit. Late closers benefit from the strong early pace that sets up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Machadadorp Impact
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomer shows significant improvement and travels strongly throughout
scenarios.body: Her unknown ability level could surprise a moderate-rated field, while the steady pace allows her to position ideally. The OR 120 rating suggests untapped potential that could overwhelm this company if genuine.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to commit early, creating a stop-start rhythm with no clear leader
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace becomes problematic with several prominent runners unsure of their roles, leading to a chaotic sprint. Pure speed horses with tactical versatility can best navigate the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Gesayed setting too slow a pace early could nullify the finishing kicks of hold-up runners Lyrics Of Life and Crownright
Machadadorp's debut performance will reveal if the OR 120 rating reflects genuine ability or inflated expectations
So Regal carrying top weight may struggle if the pace becomes genuine in the final three furlongs
Light Dreamer needs to position closer than usual if the pace stays moderate to avoid being caught flat-footed
Crownright returning from 177-day layoff may need the run despite Colin Keane's presence

runners_data.name: Storm Star

runners_data.name: Angel Hunter

runners_data.name: Dingle
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent racer carrying just 127lbs but needs more pace than Colombier alone is likely to provide.

runners_data.name: Greek Order

runners_data.name: Colombier

runners_data.name: Tilted Kilt

races.paceDynamic: Colombier will take this race forward as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a steady gallop without pressure from the gates. Storm Star and Dingle are the only prominent racers who could track close but both prefer to sit just off the pace rather than challenge early. This creates a tactical race where the large field of hold-up horses including Angel Hunter, Greek Order, Tilted Kilt, Saytarr, Dosman, Joolianoss and Dapper Guest will be relying on Colombier's tempo and hoping for gaps in the straight. The uncontested lead and weight of numbers sitting behind clearly favours front-running and prominent racing styles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Colombier maintains a steady gallop without serious challenge until the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. Hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the change of pace having been lulled by the sedate early gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the strong pace they need in the final two furlongs when the race comes alive. Class horses with finishing kicks can pick off a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Star or Dingle can position perfectly in second or third tracking Colombier
scenarios.body: The prominent racers avoid the traffic problems of the hold-up horses while getting first run on the tiring leader. They benefit from a true pace without being trapped behind walls of horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Colombier goes too slow and the field remains tightly bunched entering the straight
scenarios.body: A messy cavalry charge develops with interference and hard luck stories throughout the field. The race becomes a lottery favouring those drawn widest with clearest runs.

watchPoints.text: Colombier could steal this if allowed an easy lead throughout as the hold-up horses may struggle to reel him in
Traffic problems likely in straight as nine hold-up horses will be looking for gaps behind a slow early pace
Storm Star and Dingle are the only horses positioned to track the leader early and avoid the closing rush
Angel Hunter's recent win came from a different tactical scenario and may struggle if no pace develops
Several apprentice jockeys including Alfie Redman and Taryn Langley need to judge the pace correctly from awkward positions
